summary.motive: Create guaranteed separation against man coverage through two crossing shallow routes that naturally screen each other's defenders.
summary.whyItWorks: Man defenders must turn and chase crossing routes, which means they cannot see the second crosser arriving — the collision at the mesh point is structural, not luck.
summary.failureMode: Zone coverage lets defenders pass off the crossers without turning their heads, keeping two bodies in every shallow window.

beats.title: 1. The Crossers Depart
beats.text: Both inside receivers sell one vertical step before snapping down into the six-yard lanes. In man coverage, both defenders must turn their backs to the quarterback to chase.

beats.title: 2. The First Read Is Taken Away
beats.text: The boundary crosser's defender stays attached. The quarterback rides without panic — the Air Raid rule is simple: never throw a covered receiver.

beats.title: 3. The Rub Forms
beats.text: The second crosser arrives exactly where the first was defended. The chasing nickel is screened by the first crosser's body — an unavoidable natural pick.

beats.title: 4. The Pitch and Catch
beats.text: With the nickel picked and the Mike sorted too late, the second crosser comes open in stride. The quarterback delivers and the chain moves.

relations.tell: Both inside receivers take identical one-step vertical fakes before breaking at exactly six yards.
